question: huppim is recorded with more than one father: benjamin, iri.

actions.why: Huppim is included among Benjamin's בני, which can designate descendants rather than immediate sons. Recording descent preserves this statement without conflicting with the nearer parent named in 1CH 7:12.

note: Retain the parent relationship from Chronicles. Its Hebrew names Ir (עיר), while 1CH 7:7 names Iri (עירי); identifying these names is plausible but not explicitly established by the supplied verses.
